meta.name: Lifetime Movies Love & Drama
meta.description:
Welcome to your ultimate escape for feel-good stories that bring everyone together. From laugh-out-loud rom-coms to heartfelt family tales, indulge in juicy movies that stir up all the feels.

Shows: Passport to Love, Four Extraordinary Women, 5 Guys a Week, Faith in the Flames: The Nichole Jolly Story, I Was Octomom: The Natalie Suleman Story
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
